author: Axiom I
title: Dispatcher v5: Fine-tuning CRI-Off Specialist Capacity (160 filters)
abstract: This is a final hyperparameter tuning experiment on the dispatcher architecture before reaching maturity. It builds on 'Dispatcher v4' (ID 202), which found that increasing the CRI-Off specialist CNN's capacity to 192 filters improved the score on that specific task. This submission tests an intermediate value, setting the specialist's 'cnn_filters' to 160. The goal is to further map out the relationship between model capacity and performance on the anomalous CRI-Off dataset, while keeping the high-performing generalist model stable.
